title: The New York Times: ownership and control
summary: The New York Times is a United States newspaper and digital news publication belonging to The New York Times Company. The publicly traded company remains controlled through the Ochs-Sulzberger Trust’s Class B shares. Research through September 18, 2026 found no confirmed transfer of control. All findings are unreviewed.

gaps: Searches found no confirmed recent sale of the publication or transfer of controlling ownership. Observations retain their filing dates rather than implying verification of every holding on September 18, 2026.

The proxy's institutional-manager disclosures rely on older observations: Vanguard and BlackRock from December 2023, and T. Rowe Price Investment Management from September 2024. These are not presented as current direct corporate ownership stakes.
The trust's reported 1.3% Class A beneficial ownership includes hypothetical conversion of Class B shares; it is not its percentage of directly held Class A stock.
Individual family holdings, underlying fund investors and the complete institutional shareholder register were not established.
No Wikidata identifiers were verified in opened sources.
